nodes.label: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein Powder (Vanilla, 4.8 lb)
nodes.description: A large black tub of Optimum Nutrition (ON) Gold Standard 100% Whey protein powder, naturally flavored, Vanilla flavor. Net weight 4.8 lb (2.18 kg), 68 servings. Provides 24g protein, 5.5g BCAAs, and 4g glutamine & glutamic acid per serving. No artificial flavors or sweeteners. Gluten-free and banned substance-free. Product category: sports nutrition supplement sold in a gym management system.
